result.conclusion: The build observation shows successful compilation (exit code 0), which proves type correctness and syntactic validity. However, it provides no evidence about runtime behavior correctness across the seven targets. Build success cannot verify: default metadata values, JSON parsing logic for multiple hex formats, reactive data binding updates, menu/toolbar refresh behavior, nil-safety in Container.Add(), hyperlink callback override logic, entry minimum size calculations, or validator chaining. Runtime behavior requires execution observation, not just compilation success.
